sources.expected_freshness: 15-minute scheduled discovery; upstream indexing and rate limits can add delay
sources.attribution_guidance: Attribute each item to its original publisher and preserve its canonical URL and publication timestamp; GDELT is the discovery index, not the reporting authority.
limitations: Only publishers in the versioned major-news allowlist can create provisional incident candidates.
News metadata is not authoritative confirmation of a physical event, impact, casualty, warning, or response status.
Items without source coordinates remain list-visible but cannot create a map point.
Rate limits and upstream indexing gaps are explicit ingestion failures, not evidence that no disaster occurred.
